lines.en: He also said that he lost his favorite pen because of the ship rocking so much.
lines.cn: 他还说，船摇晃得太厉害，把他最喜欢的钢笔弄丢了。

lines.en: How did that happen?
lines.cn: 这是怎么发生的？

lines.en: After writing to his wife last night, he left the pen on his desk.
lines.cn: 昨晚他给妻子写完信后，把钢笔留在了书桌上。

lines.en: It rolled off the desk and fell into the trash can.
lines.cn: 它从桌子上滚下来，掉进了垃圾桶里。

lines.en: He threw away his garbage this morning not knowing the pen was inside.
lines.cn: 今天早上他把垃圾扔了，却不知道里面有笔。

lines.en: What a shame!
lines.cn: 真可惜！

lines.en: Third Officer, will you give me some liquid soap for the toilet in the wheel house?
lines.cn: 三副，请给我一些液体肥皂，用在驾驶台的厕所里。

lines.en: Sure, I'll go and get some.
lines.cn: 当然，我去拿一些。

lines.en: It goes quickly because everybody always washes their hands.
lines.cn: 大家经常洗手，所以洗手液用得很快。

lines.en: Well, we are always worried about food poisoning and infections on board,
lines.cn: 我们总是担心船上的食物中毒和感染，

lines.en: so the steward crew wash their hands before they start cooking.
lines.cn: 所以厨师长服务员在开始做饭前要洗手。

lines.en: The Chief Cook washes his hands whenever he enters the galley.
lines.cn: 厨师长每次进入厨房都洗手。

lines.en: That makes sense.
lines.cn: 这说得通。

lines.en: Once, a mess boy was cleaning the galley with his pants rolled up.
lines.cn: 有一次，一个服务生卷着裤子打扫厨房。

lines.en: When he finished cleaning,
lines.cn: 当他打扫完后，

lines.en: he rolled his pants down and served a dish without washing his hands first.
lines.cn: 他把裤子放了下来，没有先洗手就上菜了。

lines.en: He got into a lot of trouble for that.
lines.cn: 他因此惹了很多麻烦。

lines.en: Sanitation is important on board.
lines.cn: 船上的卫生很重要。

lines.en: We always have to be careful.
lines.cn: 我们总是要小心。

lines.en: Some infections can spread through contaminated hands or contact.
lines.cn: 有些感染可通过受污染的手或接触传播。

lines.en: There is no doctor on board so we must all pay attention to our hygiene.
lines.cn: 船上没有医生，所以我们都必须注意卫生。

lines.en: Recently,
lines.cn: 最近，

lines.en: several people developed an infection.
lines.cn: 有几个人出现了感染。

lines.en: Proper handwashing with soap is important.
lines.cn: 用肥皂正确洗手很重要。

lines.en: An outbreak on board could be serious.
lines.cn: 船上发生感染暴发可能带来严重后果。

lines.en: We should follow the vessel's hygiene procedures.
lines.cn: 我们应遵守本船卫生程序。

lines.en: I'll make sure to always wash my hands.
lines.cn: 我一定要经常洗手。

lines.en: I'm tired of starting cleaning at 6:30 every morning.
lines.cn: 我厌倦了每天早上六点半开始打扫卫生。

lines.en: Did you say something?
lines.cn: 你说什么了吗？

lines.en: No, I was just talking to myself.
lines.cn: 不，我只是在自言自语。

lines.en: How do you think the rest of the crew would feel if the whole place was dirty when they got up?
lines.cn: 你觉得其他船员起床后发现整个地方都很脏会怎么想？

lines.en: You're right.
lines.cn: 你是对的。

lines.en: Since we clean every day,
lines.cn: 因为我们每天打扫，

lines.en: it doesn't get too dirty.
lines.cn: 它不会太脏。

lines.en: If we only cleaned when it was very dirty,
lines.cn: 如果我们只在它很脏的时候清洗，

lines.en: it would be a lot harder.
lines.cn: 那就难多了。

lines.en: We clean this area every day,
lines.cn: 我们每天都打扫这个区域，

lines.en: but what about the rest of the boat?
lines.cn: 那船的其他部分呢？

lines.en: We clean the walls and ceilings in the General Office, too.
lines.cn: 我们也打扫办公室的墙壁和天花板。

lines.en: You may not notice easily,
lines.cn: 你可能不容易注意到，

lines.en: but tar and nicotine from cigarettes make walls and ceilings turn ugly yellow.
lines.cn: 但是香烟中的焦油和尼古丁会使墙壁和天花板变成难看的黄色。

lines.en: Yes, that's right.
lines.cn: 是的，没错。

lines.en: I've noticed lots of oil stains in the corridors.
lines.cn: 我注意到走廊上有很多油渍。

lines.en: Well, the ship is our home and a clean ship is a safe ship.
lines.cn: 船是我们的家，干净的船才是安全的船。

lines.en: I understand.
lines.cn: 我明白了。

lines.en: If the whole place was dirty,
lines.cn: 如果整个地方都很脏，

lines.en: if the paint was peeling off,
lines.cn: 如果油漆脱落了，

lines.en: if it was rusty all over,
lines.cn: 如果船上到处锈迹斑斑，

lines.en: and if there were things lying around,
lines.cn: 如果周围有东西乱放，

lines.en: I would feel like I was on a rotten ship.
lines.cn: 我会觉得自己待在一艘破败的船上。

lines.en: And I wouldn't care about it.
lines.cn: 那样我也可能不再爱护它。

lines.en: Exactly.
lines.cn: 完全正确。

lines.en: Feeling good about the ship makes you feel good about yourself.
lines.cn: 对这艘船感觉良好会让你对自己感觉良好。

lines.en: First, start sweeping. Mike,
lines.cn: 首先，开始扫地。迈克，

lines.en: start vacuuming A-Deck.
lines.cn: 开始吸尘A甲板。

lines.en: Yes, sir.
lines.cn: 是的，先生。

lines.en: As for the rest of you,
lines.cn: 至于你们其余的人，

lines.en: go to A-Deck and get the buckets,
lines.cn: 去A甲板拿桶来，

lines.en: sponges, mops, and liquid soap.
lines.cn: 海绵、拖把和液体肥皂。

lines.en: Then clean the walls and ceilings.
lines.cn: 然后打扫墙壁和天花板。

lines.en: Wipe the fluorescent lamps, too.
lines.cn: 把荧光灯也擦干净。

lines.en: Yes, sir. What should I use for the tough oily spots?
lines.cn: 是的，先生。我应该用什么来对付顽固的油性斑点？

lines.en: Use the approved detergent at the specified dilution and wipe the surface thoroughly.
lines.cn: 按规定稀释比例使用认可的清洁剂，彻底擦拭表面。

lines.en: If the stain remains, check the approved cleaning procedure before using another product.
lines.cn: 如污渍仍未去除，改用其他产品前先查阅经批准的清洁程序。

lines.en: OK. I'll try that.
lines.cn: 好的。我来试试。

lines.en: After washing with soap,
lines.cn: 用肥皂洗净后，

lines.en: change the water and rinse the whole place with clean water.
lines.cn: 换水，用清水冲洗整个地方。

lines.en: That gets rid of all the dirt.
lines.cn: 这样可以清除所有的污垢。

lines.en: I'll change the water now.
lines.cn: 我现在就去换水。

lines.en: After you finish cleaning the walls and ceiling,
lines.cn: 你打扫完墙壁和天花板后，

lines.en: you must mop the floor.
lines.cn: 你必须拖地。

lines.en: Remember to change the water frequently.
lines.cn: 记得经常换水。

lines.en: Yes, sir.
lines.cn: 是的，先生。

lines.en: For oily or greasy areas, use the approved cleaning product as directed,
lines.cn: 有油污的地方，应按说明使用认可的清洁用品，

lines.en: and then mop again.
lines.cn: 然后再拖地。

lines.en: Should we polish the doorknobs?
lines.cn: 我们要把门把手擦亮吗？

lines.en: After you finish mopping.
lines.cn: 你拖地完之后。

lines.en: Cadet,
lines.cn: 实习生，

lines.en: I finished mopping the floor.
lines.cn: 我把地拖完了。

lines.en: Shall I go down one deck?
lines.cn: 我下一层好吗？

lines.en: Not yet.
lines.cn: 先别下去。

lines.en: We should take a break.
lines.cn: 我们应该休息一下。

lines.en: Mike, will you go to the deck office and make some coffee for us?
lines.cn: 迈克，你能去甲板办公室给我们煮点咖啡吗？

lines.en: Yes, sir.
lines.cn: 是的，先生。

lines.en: I'll carry down these sponges to the next deck on my way to the deck office.
lines.cn: 我会在去甲板办公室的路上把这些海绵带到下一层甲板。

lines.en: Thank you.
lines.cn: 谢谢你。

lines.en: Good morning. Are you still sleeping?
lines.cn: 早上好。你还在睡觉吗？

lines.en: Good morning, sir.
lines.cn: 早上好，先生。

lines.en: No, I got up at 8 o'clock this morning.
lines.cn: 不，我今天早上8点起床。

lines.en: I was just reading in bed.
lines.cn: 我只是躺在床上看书。

lines.en: You should go and have breakfast now.
lines.cn: 你现在应该去吃早饭了。

lines.en: Wow, your cabin is a real pigpen.
lines.cn: 哇，你的房间真是个猪圈。

lines.en: You should clean it up.
lines.cn: 你应该把它清理干净。

lines.en: Today is a good day for that.
lines.cn: 今天是一个很好的日子。

lines.en: I was thinking of doing that myself.
lines.cn: 我自己也正打算打扫一下。

lines.en: The vessel is due for a ship sanitation inspection in China.
lines.cn: 本船将在中国接受船舶卫生检查。

lines.en: So you must clean everywhere,
lines.cn: 所以你必须到处打扫，

lines.en: even under the bed.
lines.cn: 甚至在床底下。

lines.en: Make sure you dust, too.
lines.cn: 你也要掸掸灰尘。

lines.en: What do they check during the inspection?
lines.cn: 他们在检查时都检查什么？

lines.en: They check if the ship meets the standard rules for sanitation.
lines.cn: 他们检查船舶是否符合卫生标准。

lines.en: For example, if they find cockroaches or mouse droppings,
lines.cn: 例如，如果他们发现蟑螂或老鼠的粪便，

lines.en: the ship will fail the inspection.
lines.cn: 这艘船不会通过检查。

lines.en: Do they check the cabins?
lines.cn: 他们也检查住舱吗？

lines.en: Yes. The inspection includes the accommodation spaces.
lines.cn: 是的。检查范围包括生活区。

lines.en: They always check the drawers under the beds to see if there is mouse excrement.
lines.cn: 他们总是检查床下的抽屉，看是否有老鼠屎。

lines.en: So you must keep them clean.
lines.cn: 所以你必须保持它们干净。

lines.en: I understand.
lines.cn: 我明白了。

lines.en: I will vacuum the whole cabin today.
lines.cn: 今天我要用吸尘器清扫整个房间。

lines.en: Good. A clean room is better for your health.
lines.cn: 好。洁净的房间对你的健康有好处。

lines.en: What's that floating in the water?
lines.cn: 漂在水里的是什么？

lines.en: It looks like oil, doesn't it?
lines.cn: 它看起来像油，不是吗？

lines.en: That's terrible!
lines.cn: 那太可怕了！

lines.en: Who would do such a thing?
lines.cn: 谁会做这种事？

lines.en: It may be a discharge from another vessel, but we cannot identify the source from here.
lines.cn: 可能是其他船舶的排放，但我们无法在这里确认来源。

lines.en: How awful!
lines.cn: 多么可怕啊！

lines.en: Do you think that it will wash away?
lines.cn: 你认为它会被冲走吗？

lines.en: In the deep sea,
lines.cn: 在深海中，

lines.en: everyone thinks that everything will wash away,
lines.cn: 每个人都认为一切都会被冲走，

lines.en: but thinking like that is spoiling the sea.
lines.cn: 但这样的想法是在糟蹋大海。

lines.en: Nature is being destroyed.
lines.cn: 自然正在被破坏。

lines.en: And it's not only because of oil spills.
lines.cn: 这不仅仅是因为油泄漏。

lines.en: Yes, I saw a lot of plastic bottles floating around, too.
lines.cn: 是的，我还看到很多塑料瓶漂浮在水面上。

lines.en: Follow the port's waste-discharge restrictions.
lines.cn: 遵守港口的废物排放限制。

lines.en: MARPOL regulates the discharge of oil and oily mixtures.
lines.cn: MARPOL对油及含油混合物的排放作出规定。

lines.en: The port authority prohibits dumping garbage overboard.
lines.cn: 港口当局禁止向舷外倾倒垃圾。

lines.en: Oily bilge water and ship-generated garbage must be managed under the applicable requirements.
lines.cn: 含油舱底水及船舶产生的垃圾须按适用要求管理。

lines.en: Our disposal standards on board meet these rules.
lines.cn: 我们船上的处理标准符合这些规定。

lines.en: Additional discharge restrictions may apply in this coastal State's waters.
lines.cn: 该沿海国水域内可能还有其他排放限制。

lines.en: So we should never throw garbage into the sea.
lines.cn: 所以我们不应该把垃圾扔进海里。

lines.en: Exactly, not even a beer can or a cigarette butt.
lines.cn: 没错，连啤酒罐和烟头都不行。

lines.en: Is your washing finished?
lines.cn: 你的衣服洗完了吗？

lines.en: It will be soon. I'll tell you when it's done.
lines.cn: 很快就会了。完成后我会告诉你的。

lines.en: It's now in the spin cycle so it'll just be one or two more minutes.
lines.cn: 现在正在脱水，还要一两分钟。

lines.en: I saw someone rinsing something under running water.
lines.cn: 我看到有人在流水下冲洗东西。

lines.en: Isn't that wasteful?
lines.cn: 这不是浪费吗？

lines.en: Even though the evaporator produces fresh water, we should still conserve it.
lines.cn: 即使造水装置能生产淡水，我们仍应节约使用。

lines.en: Right. I also try not to use too much detergent.
lines.cn: 正确的。我也尽量不要用太多的洗涤剂。

lines.en: That way it takes less fresh water to rinse my laundry.
lines.cn: 这样漂洗衣物就能少用一些淡水。

lines.en: I bought this detergent in China.
lines.cn: 我在中国买了这种洗涤剂。

lines.en: It's really strong so just one little scoop does the job!
lines.cn: 它真的很浓，所以只要一小勺就够了！

lines.en: Follow the approved environmental procedures when using cleaning products.
lines.cn: 使用清洁用品时，应遵守经批准的环保程序。

lines.en: Use products suitable for the task and follow the disposal instructions.
lines.cn: 使用适合该任务的产品，并遵守处置说明。

lines.en: Next time we stop in China,
lines.cn: 下次我们在中国停留时，

lines.en: I'll buy some, too.
lines.cn: 我也要买一些。

lines.en: OK, I'm done.
lines.cn: 好了，我做完了。

lines.en: I'll hang up my clothes now.
lines.cn: 我现在要把衣服挂起来。

lines.en: Wow! You have a lot of clothes to wash!
lines.cn: 哇！你有很多衣服要洗！

lines.en: I've been very busy and I haven't been doing much washing.
lines.cn: 我一直很忙，没怎么洗衣服。

lines.en: I do not have anything clean to wear.
lines.cn: 我没有干净衣服可穿了。

lines.en: You have to stay clean or you'll get sick.
lines.cn: 你必须保持清洁，否则你会生病的。

lines.en: No matter how busy you are,
lines.cn: 不管你有多忙，

lines.en: you should always wash your clothes.
lines.cn: 你应该经常洗衣服。

lines.en: I know. I was just lazy.
lines.cn: 我知道。我只是懒了。

lines.en: I won't let it happen again.
lines.cn: 我不会再让这种事发生了。

lines.en: You shouldn't eat so quickly!
lines.cn: 你不应该吃得这么快！

lines.en: I'm starving.
lines.cn: 我饿死了。

lines.en: And this food is so good that I can't help it.
lines.cn: 这食物太好吃了，我忍不住要吃。

lines.en: In China,
lines.cn: 在中国，

lines.en: we say that chewing your food well keeps you in good health.
lines.cn: 我们说好好咀嚼食物能让你保持健康。

lines.en: I see.
lines.cn: 我明白了。

lines.en: Don't you like vegetables?
lines.cn: 你不喜欢吃蔬菜吗？

lines.en: Yes, I do.
lines.cn: 是的，我喜欢。

lines.en: But the meat here is so good that I only eat meat and fish.
lines.cn: 但是这里的肉太好吃了，所以我只吃肉和鱼。

lines.en: It's easier for us to serve meat and fish on board.
lines.cn: 我们在船上供应肉和鱼比较方便。

lines.en: It is harder to preserve vegetables.
lines.cn: 保存蔬菜更难了。

lines.en: And it's wasteful to have all these leftover vegetables.
lines.cn: 这么多蔬菜剩下不吃，也很浪费。

lines.en: I have heard different opinions about whether meat is more nutritious than vegetables.
lines.cn: 关于肉类是否比蔬菜更有营养，我听过不同看法。

lines.en: Different foods provide different nutrients.
lines.cn: 不同食物提供不同的营养素。

lines.en: The important point is to eat a varied, balanced diet.
lines.cn: 重要的是饮食多样、营养均衡。

lines.en: A balanced diet is important.
lines.cn: 均衡饮食很重要。

lines.en: So I should eat some vegetables, too?
lines.cn: 所以我也应该吃一些蔬菜吗？

lines.en: Definitely. Good health depends on a balanced diet.
lines.cn: 当然。身体健康有赖于均衡饮食。

lines.en: A balanced diet includes a suitable variety of foods,
lines.cn: 均衡饮食应包括适当种类的食物，

lines.en: including vegetables.
lines.cn: 其中包括蔬菜。

lines.en: I know. Moderation, eating balanced meals,
lines.cn: 我知道。适度，均衡饮食，

lines.en: and exercising regularly are the basics of good health.
lines.cn: 经常锻炼是身体健康的基础。

lines.en: Excuse me, Second Officer.
lines.cn: 打扰一下，二副。

lines.en: I have a stomachache.
lines.cn: 我肚子疼。

lines.en: Can you give me some medicine?
lines.cn: 你能给我一些药吗？

lines.en: Let me see. Where does it hurt?
lines.cn: 让我看看。哪里疼？

lines.en: Here, in the lower part of my right side.
lines.cn: 这里，右下腹。

lines.en: It's painful.
lines.cn: 很疼。

lines.en: When did the pain start?
lines.cn: 什么时候开始疼的？

lines.en: This morning.
lines.cn: 今天早上。

lines.en: I have been trying to eat well and I have been chewing my food more carefully under the advice of the Chief Officer.
lines.cn: 我一直尽量规律饮食，并按大副的建议细嚼慢咽。

lines.en: Do you have diarrhea?
lines.cn: 你腹泻吗？

lines.en: No, not at all.
lines.cn: 不，一点也不。

lines.en: Do you have a fever?
lines.cn: 你发烧吗？

lines.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Stand by engine.
lines.cn: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。备车。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Stand by engine, understood.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。备车，收到。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Engine is ready.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。主机备妥。

lines.en: Engine room, this is bridge. Finished with engines.
lines.cn: 机舱，这里是驾驶台。完车。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Finished with engines, understood.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。完车，收到。

lines.en: Dead slow ahead.
lines.cn: 微速前进。

lines.en: Dead slow ahead, engine is dead slow ahead.
lines.cn: 微速前进，主机微速前进。

lines.en: Half astern.
lines.cn: 半速后退。

lines.en: Half astern, engine is half astern.
lines.cn: 半速后退，主机半速后退。

lines.en: Full ahead.
lines.cn: 全速前进。

lines.en: Full ahead, engine is full ahead.
lines.cn: 全速前进，主机全速前进。

lines.en: Stop engine.
lines.cn: 停车。

lines.en: Stop engine, engine is stopped.
lines.cn: 停车，主机已停。

lines.en: Emergency stop.
lines.cn: 紧急停车。

lines.en: Emergency stop, engine is stopped immediately.
lines.cn: 紧急停车，主机立即停车。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Main engine lube oil pressure low alarm.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。主机滑油低压报警。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Generator No.2 breakdown.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。2号发电机故障。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Cooling water high temperature.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。冷却水高温。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Fuel oil pipe leakage.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。燃油管泄漏。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Fire in engine room, near boiler.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。机舱失火，锅炉附近。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Serious bilge water accumulation.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。舱底水严重积聚。

lines.en: Bridge, this is engine room. Need emergency repair immediately.
lines.cn: 驾驶台，这里是机舱。需立即应急修理。

lines.en: I have made rounds of engine room. All parameters normal.
lines.cn: 我已完成机舱巡检，所有参数正常。

lines.en: No abnormal noise, no leakage found.
lines.cn: 未发现异常噪音和泄漏。

lines.en: All pumps and motors running well.
lines.cn: 所有泵浦和电机运行良好。

lines.en: I am cleaning the fuel oil filter.
lines.cn: 我正在清洗燃油滤器。

lines.en: I will change the lube oil of main engine.
lines.cn: 我要更换主机滑油。

lines.en: Please stand by. I am testing the alarm system.
lines.cn: 请稍候。我正在测试报警系统。

lines.en: I am taking over duty. Any special orders?
lines.cn: 我来接班，有特殊指令吗？

lines.en: Any problems with the machinery?
lines.cn: 机械设备有问题吗？

lines.en: All machinery running normally. No special orders.
lines.cn: 所有机械运行正常，无特殊指令。

lines.en: Generator No.1 under maintenance, No.2 and 3 in operation.
lines.cn: 1号发电机在保养，2、3号运行中。

lines.en: Please monitor main engine exhaust temperature closely.
lines.cn: 请密切监控主机排气温度。

lines.en: Handover completed.
lines.cn: 交接完毕。

lines.en: Understood. I will take over now.
lines.cn: 明白，我现在接班。

lines.en: Show me the engine logbook.
lines.cn: 给我看轮机日志。

lines.en: Here you are.
lines.cn: 给您。

lines.en: When did you test the fire pump?
lines.cn: 你们何时测试的消防泵？

lines.en: We tested it yesterday, everything in good order.
lines.cn: 昨天测试的，一切正常。

lines.en: Any deficiencies recently?
lines.cn: 近期有缺陷吗？

lines.en: No deficiencies found.
lines.cn: 未发现缺陷。

lines.en: Have you received the latest NAVTEX weather report?
lines.cn: 你收到最新的 NAVTEX 气象报告了吗？

lines.en: The synopsis shows a deep depression centred at 45°N 160°E, moving east at 25 knots.
lines.cn: 天气形势显示一个深低压中心位于北纬45度、东经160度，正以25节向东移动。

lines.en: Are there any gale warnings for our area?
lines.cn: 我们海域有大风警告吗？

lines.en: Gale warning is issued for area east of 150°E, with winds up to Force 8 to 9 and sea state becoming rough.
lines.cn: 东经150度以东海域有大风警告，风力达8到9级，海况将变得恶劣。

lines.en: What is the forecast for the next 24 hours?
lines.cn: 未来24小时预报如何？

lines.en: Winds expected to increase further, visibility moderate to poor in rain showers.
lines.cn: 风力预计进一步加强，能见度中等至不良，有阵雨。

lines.en: Keep monitoring the weather fax and update me if anything changes.
lines.cn: 继续接收并查看气象传真图，有变化及时报告。

lines.en: Captain, the latest typhoon warning shows Tropical Storm 'MILA' has intensified into a Severe Tropical Storm, currently at 18°N 125°E, moving NW at 12 knots.
lines.cn: 船长，最新台风警报显示热带风暴'米拉'已增强为强热带风暴，目前位于北纬18度东经125度，向西北移动，速度12节。

lines.en: Plot its position and projected track on the chart. How far is it from our intended route?
lines.cn: 在海图上标出它的位置和预测路径。距离我们计划航线有多远？

lines.en: About 300 nautical miles to the southeast. The forecast track shows it may cross our route in 48 hours.
lines.cn: 大约东南方向300海里。预报路径显示它可能在48小时后穿越我们的航线。

lines.en: The storm may create dangerous conditions along our route. Assess our position, sea room and the forecast before deciding on an alteration.
lines.cn: 风暴可能使计划航线出现危险海况。决定改向前，先评估本船位置、海上余地及预报。

lines.en: I agree. We should also reduce speed to avoid heavy pounding and secure all loose gear on deck.
lines.cn: 同意。应该减速以避免剧烈颠簸，固定甲板上所有松动设备。

lines.en: Should I inform the company and send a diversion report?
lines.cn: 需要通知公司并发送改航报告吗？

lines.en: Yes. Prepare a message with our new course, speed, and ETA changes. Safety first.
lines.cn: 是的。准备一份电文，写明我们的新航向、速度和预计到港时间变化。安全第一。

lines.en: Visibility has dropped to less than 1 nautical mile. Fog is setting in fast.
lines.cn: 能见度降至不到1海里。雾来得很快。

lines.en: This looks like advection fog - warm moist air over the cold current. Sound the fog signal as per COLREGS.
lines.cn: 看起来像平流雾——暖湿空气经过冷水流。按照《国际海上避碰规则》鸣放雾号。

lines.en: Shall we verify both radars and post an additional lookout forward?
lines.cn: 是否检查确认两部雷达的状态，并在船首增派瞭望人员？

lines.en: Use both radars at appropriate range scales, maintain a proper lookout and proceed at a safe speed.
lines.cn: 两部雷达采用适当量程，保持正规瞭望，并以安全航速航行。

lines.en: The sea surface temperature has dropped 3 degrees in the last hour. That explains the fog formation.
lines.cn: 海面水温在过去一小时内下降了3度。这就解释了雾的形成原因。

lines.en: Check the barometer and the latest forecast. Do not infer how long the fog will last from pressure alone.
lines.cn: 查看气压计和最新预报，不要只根据气压推断雾会持续多久。

lines.en: Understood. I will keep monitoring the radar and report any contacts immediately.
lines.cn: 明白。我会持续监控雷达，发现目标立即报告。

lines.en: It's time for the 0800 weather observation. Let's go to the bridge wing.
lines.cn: 到0800时气象观测时间了，我们去驾驶台翼部。

lines.en: Wind is from 230 degrees at 22 knots, gusting 28. Cloud cover is 7 oktas, mainly Cumulus and Stratocumulus.
lines.cn: 风从230度方向吹来，风速22节，阵风28节。云量7/8，主要为积云和层积云。

lines.en: What is the visibility and present weather?
lines.cn: 能见度和当前天气如何？

lines.en: Visibility is 8 nautical miles. Light drizzle observed. Air temperature 15°C, sea surface temperature 12°C.
lines.cn: 能见度8海里。观测到轻微毛毛雨。气温15摄氏度，海面水温12摄氏度。

lines.en: Barometric pressure reading is 1012.5 hPa, falling slowly at 0.3 hPa per hour. Dew point is 10°C.
lines.cn: 气压读数为1012.5百帕，缓慢下降，每小时下降0.3百帕。露点10摄氏度。

lines.en: Record everything in the weather logbook. The falling pressure may indicate an approaching low pressure system.
lines.cn: 把所有这些记录到气象日志中。气压下降可能表明有低压系统正在靠近。

lines.en: I'll also compare with the latest weather fax to see if the forecast matches our observations.
lines.cn: 我再对比一下最新的气象传真图，看看预报是否与我们的观测一致。

lines.en: The ASAS chart just came in. Let's analyze the synoptic situation.
lines.cn: 地面分析图刚传过来了。我们分析一下天气形势。

lines.en: There is a mature low pressure system at 50°N 170°W, with a cold front extending southward and a warm front eastward.
lines.cn: 在北纬50度西经170度有一个成熟低压系统，冷锋向南延伸，暖锋向东延伸。

lines.en: The isobars are very tightly packed near the front. That means strong winds, possibly gale force.
lines.cn: 锋面附近的等压线非常密集。这意味着强风，可能达到大风级别。

lines.en: Look at this ridge of high pressure building from the west. It should bring improving weather after the front passes.
lines.cn: 看这边从西部发展的高压脊。在锋面过境后应该会带来好转的天气。

lines.en: What about the wave chart? How is the sea state expected?
lines.cn: 波浪图怎么样？海况预计如何？

lines.en: The FWPN shows significant wave height of 5 to 6 meters in the frontal zone, with long period swell from the northwest.
lines.cn: 波浪预报图显示锋面区域有效波高5到6米，有来自西北方向的长周期涌浪。

lines.en: Compare the forecast conditions along the available routes and prepare a revised passage plan for review.
lines.cn: 比较各可选航线的预报海况，编制修订航次计划供审核。

lines.en: Chief Officer, we need to plan our trans-Pacific route considering the seasonal weather patterns.
lines.cn: 大副，我们需要考虑季节性天气模式来规划我们的跨太平洋航线。

lines.en: According to the Routeing Charts for January, we should take the southern route to avoid the Aleutian low pressure systems.
lines.cn: 根据一月份的航路设计图，我们应该走南线航线，避开阿留申低压系统。

lines.en: The wind rose indicates prevailing northwesterly winds. Assess the relative wind and waves for each proposed course.
lines.cn: 风玫瑰图显示盛行西北风，应评估各拟定航向上的相对风浪。

lines.en: What about the Kuroshio Current? It flows northeastward here at 2 to 3 knots.
lines.cn: 黑潮海流怎么样？它在这里以2到3节的速度向东北方向流动。

lines.en: We can take advantage of the warm current on our way east to gain some speed and save fuel.
lines.cn: 东行时可以借助这股暖流提高航速并节省燃油。

lines.en: Also, check the ice limits for this season. We must stay well south of the ice edge.
lines.cn: 另外，查一下本季的冰区界限。我们必须保持在冰区边缘以南足够远的安全距离。

lines.en: Will prepare a preliminary route plan using the Routeing Charts and the latest weather forecast for review.
lines.cn: 我会用航路设计图和最新天气预报准备好初步航线方案供审核。

lines.en: Harbor VTS, Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean on VHF channel 16. How do you read me?
lines.cn: 港口交管，港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，在VHF 16频道呼叫。收听情况如何？

lines.en: Blue Ocean, this is Harbor VTS. I read you loud and clear.
lines.cn: Blue Ocean轮，这里是港口交管。收听清晰。

lines.en: Change to channel one-two and stand by.
lines.cn: 请切换到12频道并守听。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Changing to channel one-two. Standing by.
lines.cn: 正在切换到12频道，保持守听。
lines.speaker: Ship

lines.en: Please confirm your call sign, present position, course and speed.
lines.cn: 请确认呼号、当前位置、航向和航速。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Call sign ABCD. Position two nautical miles east of No. 3 buoy. Course 085 degrees, speed 10 knots.
lines.cn: 呼号ABCD。船位在3号浮标以东2海里，航向085度，航速10节。

lines.en: Keep listening watch on channel one-two and channel one-six.
lines.cn: 请在12频道和16频道保持守听。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Roger. We will keep listening watch on channel one-two and channel one-six.
lines.cn: 收到。我船将在12频道和16频道保持守听。
lines.speaker: Ship

lines.en: Harbor VTS, this is Blue Ocean entering the traffic separation scheme.
lines.cn: 港口交管，这里是Blue Ocean轮，正进入分道通航制水域。

lines.en: Report your last port, next port and ETA to the pilot station.
lines.cn: 请报告上一港、下一港和到引航站的预计时间。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Last port Singapore, next port Ningbo. ETA pilot station one-four-zero-zero local time.
lines.cn: 上一港新加坡，下一港宁波。预计当地时间14点到引航站。
lines.speaker: Ship

lines.en: Reduce speed to eight knots and keep to the starboard side of the channel.
lines.cn: 减速到8节，靠航道右侧航行。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Reducing speed to eight knots and keeping to starboard side.
lines.cn: 正在减速到8节，并靠右侧航行。
lines.speaker: Ship

lines.en: A crossing vessel is on your port bow. Keep clear and report when that vessel is abeam of you.
lines.cn: 你船左舷首有一艘横越船。请让清，并在该船位于你船正横时报告。

lines.en: We have the crossing vessel in sight and will keep clear.
lines.cn: 我船已看到该横越船，将保持让清。
lines.speaker: Ship

lines.en: Report any change of course or engine status immediately.
lines.cn: 如航向或主机状态有变化，请立即报告。
lines.speaker: VTS

lines.en: Vessel on my starboard bow, this is Blue Ocean. What are your intentions?
lines.cn: 本船右舷首的船舶，这里是Blue Ocean轮。你船意图是什么？

lines.en: I intend to alter course to starboard and pass port to port.
lines.cn: 我船准备向右转向，左舷对左舷通过。
lines.speaker: Ship B

lines.en: Agreed. I will maintain my course and speed until you are clear.
lines.cn: 同意。我船保持航向航速，直到你船让清。
lines.speaker: Ship A

lines.en: Your CPA is too small. Please take early action.
lines.cn: 你船最近会遇距离太小，请及早采取行动。
lines.speaker: Ship A

lines.en: I am reducing speed and altering course to starboard now.
lines.cn: 我船正在减速并向右转向。
lines.speaker: Ship B

lines.en: We are approaching the anchorage and preparing both anchors.
lines.cn: 我船正接近锚地，准备双锚。
lines.speaker: Ship A

lines.en: Let go starboard anchor in position three-six degrees one-two minutes north, one-two-two degrees zero-eight minutes east.
lines.cn: 在北纬36度12分、东经122度08分位置抛右锚。
lines.speaker: Ship A

lines.en: Five shackles are in the water. The vessel is brought up and not dragging anchor.
lines.cn: 入水5节锚链。船已锚住，没有走锚。
lines.speaker: Ship A

lines.en: Chief Engineer, please show me the engine room logbook and oil record book.
lines.cn: 轮机长，请出示机舱日志和油类记录簿。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: The engine-room logbook is up to date. The Oil Record Book has been completed and signed in accordance with the applicable requirements.
lines.cn: 机舱日志已及时填写。《油类记录簿》已按适用要求填写并签署。

lines.en: Is the oily water separator operational?
lines.cn: 油水分离器工作正常吗？
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: Yes. It was tested this morning, and the fifteen ppm alarm worked normally.
lines.cn: 正常。今天早上测试过，15ppm报警工作正常。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: Show me the emergency generator test record.
lines.cn: 请给我看应急发电机测试记录。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: The emergency generator was tested last week under load.
lines.cn: 应急发电机上周进行了带负荷测试。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: Can you demonstrate the emergency fire pump?
lines.cn: 能演示一下应急消防泵吗？
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: Yes. We will start it from the emergency fire pump room now.
lines.cn: 可以。我们现在从应急消防泵间启动。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: Are the quick closing valves tested regularly?
lines.cn: 速闭阀是否定期测试？
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: Yes. The test record is available, and the crew are familiar with the procedure.
lines.cn: 是的。有测试记录，船员也熟悉操作程序。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

data.title: 轮机缺陷整改与复查
data.titleEn: Engine Room Deficiency Rectification and Re-inspection

lines.en: I found oil leakage near the purifier. Please rectify it before departure.
lines.cn: 我在分油机附近发现漏油，请在开航前整改。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: We have stopped the purifier and replaced the damaged gasket.
lines.cn: 我们已停用分油机并更换损坏的垫片。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: The insulation on this exhaust pipe is missing.
lines.cn: 这段排气管隔热层缺失。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: We will renew the insulation and take photos as rectification evidence.
lines.cn: 我们会更新隔热层，并拍照作为整改证明。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: The bilge high level alarm did not activate during the test.
lines.cn: 舱底水高位报警在测试时没有动作。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: The electrician is checking the sensor and alarm circuit now.
lines.cn: 电机员正在检查传感器和报警线路。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: Please record the rectification in the maintenance log.
lines.cn: 请把整改情况记录在维护日志中。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: The defect has been rectified and recorded. Please re-inspect it.
lines.cn: 缺陷已整改并记录，请复查。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer

lines.en: The equipment is now in good working order.
lines.cn: 设备现在工作状态良好。
lines.speaker: PSCO

lines.en: Thank you. We will keep monitoring it during the voyage.
lines.cn: 谢谢。航行期间我们会继续监控。
lines.speaker: Chief Engineer
